title: Ferbos as a teacher

blocks.x: Being as good a musician as you are, I'm talking to you, did you ever teach anybody around here to play? I mean did you teach anybody around here? Oh yeah, I teach quite a bit of sports. Anybody in particular? I wouldn't know.

Well I'll tell you, one of those folks I taught, he's very fine saxophone player. In fact I didn't teach him completely but I had him for quite a while. He's still a saxophone player there. He plays with, how do you call this band, Dukes, Raul Dukes? Yeah, Emanuel's son-in-law. What's his name again? Blue, Blue, Blue, Blue, Blue, Blue, Blue. Yeah, uh-huh.
